$comment: Per-file source + license register for the S5 corpus. Every file listed here is redistributable under the stated license. Self-encoded files: melody is public domain; the encoding and chord symbols were written for this repo and dedicated CC0-1.0.

source.notes: Melody by James Lord Pierpont, published 1857 (public domain). Encoded from the traditional tune by the S5 agent; chord symbols by the encoder. Needs a human proofread against a PD edition.
Tune ANTIOCH as arranged by Lowell Mason, 1839 (public domain). Encoded from the traditional tune by the S5 agent; chord symbols by the encoder. Needs a human proofread against a PD edition.
Melody by Franz Xaver Gruber, 1818 (public domain). Encoded from the traditional tune by the S5 agent; chord symbols by the encoder. Needs a human proofread against a PD edition.

Traditional Welsh melody 'Nos Galan' (public domain); English words 1862. Encoded from the traditional tune by the S5 agent; chord symbols by the encoder. Needs a human proofread against a PD edition.
Traditional English (West Country) melody (public domain). Encoded from the traditional tune by the S5 agent; chord symbols by the encoder. Needs a human proofread against a PD edition.
